summary: Connect current commitments, scoped dependencies, executed revision closure and directly readable scoped verdicts within the existing single-session workflow.

core/docs/methods/guides/task-continuity: 同一会话内推进本轮工作
core/docs/methods/guides/review-coverage: 5. 为值得处理的缺口选择一项有界动作
core/docs/methods/guides/revision-respon: 先把问题变成可选路线
修订后收敛到当前裁定

revisit: At a stage transition, gap, revisor response or final delivery, compare current obligations, dependent actions, actual artifacts and scoped acceptance. Reuse existing Plan/report/navigation views; appraise only current or next-gate impacts.
acceptance: Preserve original commitments and historical judgments; use explicit scope revisions, actual requested execution and corresponding scientific review. Overall dependency blockage is valid after bounded alternative appraisal when all worthwhile authorized routes are blocked, including heterogeneous gaps.

change_rationale.reason: Connect same-session commitments to the next dependent action, actual execution, review and topic-level closure; retain legitimate all-route blockage with either shared or heterogeneous missing prerequisites.
change_rationale.prior_coverage: Recovery, scoped blocked work, independent authorized work, task-bound delivery and stage-to-research continuity already existed.
change_rationale.addition_needed: Make those controls explicit within one continuing session, attach judgments/execution/delivery to current obligations, and distinguish accepted stage output, complete topic and overall dependency blockage.

change_rationale.reason: Connect original questions and author commitments to actual methods/results and concluding synthesis; align bounded follow-up with existing task-based checkpoint and explicit-budget semantics.
change_rationale.prior_coverage: Purpose-specific maps, scope appraisal, evidence states, bounded alternatives and conditional closure already existed.
change_rationale.addition_needed: Separate domain motivation from undertaken work, preserve unfinished necessary work at closure, and remove the universal per-action time/paper-count cap requirement while preserving explicit authorized budgets.

change_rationale.reason: Classify request obligations, preserve original claim scope through narrowing, close actual repairs through corresponding review, and expose current scoped adjudication to final consumers.
change_rationale.prior_coverage: Atomic requests, selected-route AND/OR, route-specific inputs and record/runtime/scientific acceptance already existed.
change_rationale.addition_needed: Connect request origin to the original commitment or adopted new use, preserve original-wording verdicts alongside narrow claims, and prevent historical pending or scalar verdicts from hiding current object-specific decisions.

change_rationale.reason: Attach each later action to its own claim, evidence and revisit condition.
change_rationale.prior_coverage: Contextual observations, actual-use attribution, append-only experience, task links and later responsibility already existed.
change_rationale.addition_needed: Prevent independently applicable missing materials from becoming one global precondition for all later work.

evidence_scope: Private candidate/source review and retrospective case appraisals inform this first-party wording. The source materials remain private. No private case answers, source paper bodies or new experiment grading materials are exported into public prose.
implementation_boundary: Existing Plan, Task, Claim, Decision, Review, report and navigation carriers only.
No code, templates, schemas, manifests, required new file or mandatory new field set changed.
No new universal time limit, paper count, zero-error first draft threshold or architectural simplification.
Explicit existing authorized budgets retain their effect; process counts do not determine scientific sufficiency.
validation_scope: Writer checks exact edits, append-only note/source-index retention and JSON consistency. Parent performs final editorial acceptance, documentation refresh/check and publication verification after all writers stop.
effect_status: No prospective stability, frequency or isolated causal effect established by this documentation change; retrospective retained-context observations retain their original scope.
